# BCGov Crow - v0.20.1

## Release type

Patch release: improves review and reconciliation instructions in Getting
Started's existing task-prompt capability.

## Summary

Getting Started now includes two task-appropriate review checkpoints in both
single-route and coordinated prompts. The original task agent reconciles
the findings before dependent work continues or the final result is delivered.

## Highlights

- Prefers reviewers from a different underlying model family when available,
  while respecting current model, cost, delegation and approval policies.
- Places reviews within the approved task stage, including planning,
  architecture, implementation and research.
- Makes manual-review and unavailable-family fallbacks explicit without
  counting self-review as an independent review.

## Changes

- Updated the Getting Started agent, skill guidance and both prompt templates.
- Kept Getting Started guidance-only; generated prompts do not execute reviews.

## Validation

- Asset, local-link, package and independent-review checks are required before
  completion; exact-release publication gates remain separate.
- These notes do not attest to task execution, model availability or deployment.

## Artifacts

- Archive: `bcgov-crow-0.20.1.zip`

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.20.1 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.20.1.zip --global --target copilot
```
